diagnosis: `induction der` fails because the typing derivation is indexed by the fixed context `[]`, while recursive typing premises may use extended contexts. Generalizing the empty context index before induction makes the index a variable; `grind` can then use the resulting equality to eliminate impossible cases and discharge the constructor cases.
proof_body:
by
  generalize hΓ : ([] : Context Var) = Γ at der
  induction der <;>
    grind [cases Value, Sub.refl, Typing.abs_inv, Typing.tabs_inv,
      Typing.inl_inv, Typing.inr_inv]
